title: Quote Lock
summary: Shows a held FX, swap or fare quote counting down and makes any worse re-quote an explicit Accept step, so nobody pays a price they never saw.
description: Held-quote panel that drains as the hold ends, fetches a fresh quote (skew-safe with validFor), rolls old to new with the difference called out, turns a worse-than-tolerance price into an explicit Accept, re-quotes a late Pay, and ignores stale responses and double presses.
catches: New price worse than tolerance: Pay becomes Accept first
Pay pressed in the last seconds: re-quoted
Out-of-order quote responses and double presses
Client clock skew, when validFor is used
limits: The server's quote and its expiry are the real truth
Tolerance and direction come from your props
a11y: The amount is always in the Pay label as text
Errors use role=alert; Pay uses aria-disabled outside the hold
Animations are skipped under reduced motion
server: Honour only server-side quote IDs within their validity and reject a confirm against an expired or replaced quote; make confirm idempotent.
stops: Helps prevent paying a re-quoted price nobody saw
